name: Meant to be?
source:
Dad just got retired, and with a child studying abroad and nothing better to do, he reluctantly jumps into the wondrous world of dating!

Can he find true love (and perhaps himself along the way)?

[From [url=https://dzezabel.itch.io/meant-to-be]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爸爸刚刚退休，孩子又在国外读书，无事可做的他，只好不情不愿地踏入奇妙的约会世界！

他能找到真爱吗？或许，还能在途中找回自己？

[摘自[url=https://dzezabel.itch.io/meant-to-be]itch.io[/url]]
